summary: Frontend-only verification of new /app/agentic-ai-security module (7 tabs, mission control, inventory, authority, guardrails, shadow, incidents, defensibility). Login as admin, nav item nav-agentic-ai-security lands on route, agentic-ai-security-page renders, all 7 tabs switch and persist via localStorage key agentic-ai-security-tab. All required panel testids exist (agentic-authority-chart, agentic-guardrail-summary, agentic-owasp, agentic-top-agents, agentic-control-loop, agentic-inventory, agentic-authority-register, agentic-tools, agentic-permissions, agentic-guardrail-coverage, agentic-redteam, agentic-shadow-ai, agentic-incidents, agentic-workflows, agentic-source-status, agentic-evidence-class, agentic-runtime-boundary, agentic-connectors). AGT-001/002/003 rendered in inventory, guardrails and authority views. AGT-002 shell.exec surfaced in Tool intelligence panel. Guardrail toggle triggers PATCH /api/agents/AGT-002 -> 200. Run heuristic baseline triggers POST /api/agents/AGT-002/redteam -> 200 and HEURISTIC BASELINE label rendered. Register Agent modal opens with all fields (name, owner, model, tools csv, permissions csv, risk class select). Executive Brief button triggers POST /api/studio/report/pdf -> 200 and downloads blob. Shadow AI shows graceful 'No shadow AI systems' empty state. Incidents empty state + Governance workflows populated. Regression: /app Executive Overview and /app/sod-command still render. AIInsight advisor actually produced a live grounded narrative (not the 'no telemetry' cosmetic mismatch noted as OOS).

issues: Interactive elements lack per-item data-testid attributes for robust automation. Only panel-level testids exist. Missing recommended testids: agentic-register-agent (Register Agent button), agentic-agent-row-{ref} on inventory rows, agentic-top-agent-{ref} on Mission top-agent cards, agentic-guard-toggle-{ref}-{key} on guardrail toggle buttons, agentic-run-redteam-{ref} on Run heuristic baseline button, agentic-register-modal / agentic-register-name/owner/model/tools/permissions/risk/submit/cancel on the RegisterAgent modal, agentic-agent-detail-{close|tab-evidence|tab-ai|status-sanctioned|status-restricted|status-killed} on AgentDetailModal. Selectors currently must rely on text content which is fragile. Functionality itself works, this is testability/maintainability only.

action_items: Add per-item data-testids to interactive elements listed in design_issues (Register button, inventory rows, top-agent cards, guardrail toggles, redteam button, register modal fields, agent detail modal tabs+status buttons+close) to align with the review_request testid contract.
critical_code_review_comments: AgenticAISecurity.jsx (346 lines) is close to limits and contains all action handlers plus rendering + tab logic. Consider extracting handlers (toggleGuard, runRedteam, setAgentStatus, registerAgent, sanctionSystem, downloadBoardBrief) into a hook next to useAgenticAIData for cleaner separation.
downloadBoardBrief has no telemetry-based blocks size guard; if boardReportBlocks returns empty for a tenant with zero data the PDF may still be requested. Acceptable for now.
Frontend-only claim upheld: no backend files modified during test.
Guardrail/redteam/status toggle relies on optimistic reload; no in-flight optimistic UI, small UX friction (busy state only on ref). Acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed features work; testability gap noted
